title: Spanish Boiled Honey Sausage
description: A simple and flavorful dish combining the sweetness of honey with the savory taste of Spanish sausage.
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large pot.
Add the Spanish sausage and cook until browned.
Reduce heat to a simmer and add honey, salt, and quick boil.
Continue cooking for 10-15 minutes or until the sausage is cooked through.
